newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-EVEREN cuts Tandy EPS view.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-EVEREN cuts Tandy EPS view.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Friday it cut its fourth quarter 1996 earnings estimate for Tandy Corp to $1.26 a share from $1.40. The electronics retailer reported earnings of $1.39 in the year ago quarter, EVEREN said.
-- The estimate for 1997 was cut to $2.45 from $2.75, EVEREN said. Rating remains market performer in intermediate term and outperform long-term, EVEREN said.

-- The reduction was due to EVEREN's lower expectations for Tandy's Radio Shack stores and belief that management will continue to try to turn around Incredible Universe and Computer City Stores, EVEREN said in a research report.
The stock was up 1/8 at 40-1/8 Friday.
